findings.issue: The emitted original_utf8_failure_preserved flag is unconditional. The script reads scope for its hash but does not validate its prior_preserved bindings.
findings.requested_fix: Verify the frozen prior artifact bindings before raw interpretation, or label the flag as by-design intent and bind actual unchanged before/after artifacts externally.
findings.scope: Audit assertion precision, not a codec or scientific validity finding.

findings.issue: ASCII/nonASCII/different-cell counts only traverse eleven-column records, including the header and empty cells. Other-width records are skipped. The closed aggregate report does not explicitly label this scope.
findings.requested_fix: Emit a fixed count-scope description and explicit exclusion of other-width records so aggregates cannot be mistaken for every parsed cell.

accepted_boundaries: Only cp1252 and iso8859-1 strict decodes; no encoding winner, normalization or replacement.
csv.reader on StringIO(newline="") with explicit semicolon/quote/doublequote/noescape/strict parameters; no splitlines that would split NEL.
Identity checked before any hypothesis interpretation. Full document, examples and comments machine exposure is acknowledged.
All example-column values are withheld from internal projection; other ASCII cells, including potentially empirical comments, remain internal-only.
NonASCII/different cells receive closed status/locators; same-string nonASCII cells are still unbound. No fill-down, alternative columns, unit conversion, formula execution or link following.
Public stdout contains only fixed identity/status/structural aggregates and record locators; internal selected-cell strings are not printed.
actual_review_activity: Static reading of scope/source only; no raw schema/measurement source read, candidate import/execution, synthetic tests, network, tracked edit or Git mutation.
